selected_script.angle: Absurd adult family rescuer intervenes with a steam-assisted microwave cover to prevent messy food splatters and dry reheated meals.
selected_script.hook: Close-up of messy sauce exploding all over the microwave interior walls while reheating dry pasta.

script_record.pain_point: Microwave explosions and dry, rubbery reheated food
script_record.conflict_hook: Messy microwave sauce splatters and ruined dinner

timeline.scene: Close-up of sauce popping and splattering across microwave walls as dry pasta heats.

timeline.scene: An absurd adult grandma in full silk fencing gear marches in carrying the UFORU clear microwave splatter cover with olive green rim, placing it directly over the plate while saying 'Stop the mess!'.
Clean water is poured into the clear side reservoir; steam retains moisture as food heats neatly without splattering.
Lifting the cover using the olive-green top handle, revealing perfectly juicy, fresh-looking reheated pasta.
Showing condensation collecting in the lower channel and pouring neatly out of the lower drainage outlet.
Rinsing the transparent polycarbonate cover under the sink with quick, effortless cleanup.
Text overlay: 'A simple upgrade for everyday use. Check it out today.'

script_record.cta: A simple upgrade for everyday use. Check it out today.
